text:
lin: Quick proposal - remove the emergency runtime pin for v3.2.1 in the US-night cohort at 00:30 UTC. Fix validated in staging and small patch merged. Plan: 1% -> 5% progressive over 20m, 30m hold, ramp only if stable. Rollback triggers: error_rate >= 2% for any 5m window OR p99 latency increase > 300ms sustained for 10m.
sasha: Fine with me. Can we keep a manual rollback button as well in deploy-bot UI? Night team prefers manual confirm for the 5%->25% ramp.
deploy-bot: queued: unpin runtime v3.2.1 -> us-night cohort. Preview: `deploybot unpin --runtime v3.2.1 --cohort us-night --stages "1:10m,5:20m" --hold 1800 --auto-pin-on-sla "error>=0.02:5m,p99>300:10m"`
maria: I'll run the KV-heavy perf tests during the 30m hold. Command: `./ci/run_perf.sh --suite kv-heavy --cohort us-night --duration 35m` Will upload results to artifacts.
jun: Adding alert hook and a tiny runbook: ```if deploybot_alert: deploybot.pin(runtime='v3.2.1'); notify('#eng-oncall'); collect-traces('--sample 200')``` Also set telemetry tag `rollforward_us_night_8240001111`.
sam: SDK note: node SDK 1.5.3 keeps backward header fallback but we should call out the header rename in release note. I'll drop a short migration snippet into the changelog.
lin: Important: dedicated fleets remain pinned, this only touches hosted night canary traffic. Also doc owners: please add a curl example for the header migration.
maria: Perf run started. Interim logs show stable p50/p95; no KV header mismatches so far. Link: https://artifacts.internal/longseq/8240001111/interim.log
sasha: OK schedule it. Night ops will confirm the manual ramp step. If anything looks off we abort and pin back. :thumbsup:
